summary.name: Punk Graphics. This is a supplemental design reference, not a directly named style in the source collection.
summary.visualIdentity: Cutout lettering, torn paper, tape, photocopy grain and handwritten marks in an irregular paste-up layout. The headline stays prominent and the palette stays limited. Motion is pasting, peeling and tearing.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly suggested for posters, title cards and short protest-style edits where the cutout chaos is the message. The kinetic Punk-Zine variant suits fast intros with short heavy copy. Inferred: HTML hero slogans.
summary.limitations: Only seconds 1 to 8 of two source videos were reviewed, one frame per second; continuous motion, sub-second timing, audio and later scenes were not verified. Stock torn-paper overlays are not supplied, so tear textures must be drawn or authorized.
summary.palette: No approved palette was supplied; #EFE9D9, #171717 and #C63A3A are authored suggestions. Background is scene-dependent: #EFE9D9 is only illustrative, so choose the ground from setting and mood. Foreground on background is 14.793:1; accent on background is 4.26:1, decorative only.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Glyphs tear or brush in and build, then annotations and ornaments pop before a hold. Motion is limited to paste, tear and peel, with no smooth tracking or blur. Jitter must use a fixed seed. Interactive scroll or button reveals are optional.
summary.audio: Unspecified; no audio was supplied or analyzed. Music, voiceover, effects, ambience or silence may be proposed from the brief, and previews stay silent. Any tear or paste accent is an inference and must not compete with narration.
summary.assetRequirements: No mandatory uploads. Needed: cutout lettering with fixed-seed Pillow torn masks, halftoned photos only where used, and drawn or authorized tear textures. Fonts and assets must load before rendering.
summary.combinations: Optional motion references: motion-037, motion-038, motion-044 (bold display type only) and motion-045, each only when assets support it. Suggested hybrids: style-093 for headline timing and style-050 for halftone photos. Use Punk alone for posters and title cards.
summary.productionApproach: Pillow creates torn masks and textures; Rough.js is optional for approved sketch marks only. A single paused GSAP timeline owns motion. HyperFrames is the default pipeline; Remotion is used only if its fallback condition is met and recorded.
